section_a.rule: All students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in each registered course.

section_b.rule: Students with an approved medical exemption must maintain a minimum attendance of 60% in each registered course.

description: Section 2.1 requires 75% attendance for all students, while Section 2.3 requires 60% attendance for students with an approved medical exemption. Neither section explicitly states which rule takes precedence.

section_a.rule: The semester fee for Even Semester 2027 is due by 10 March 2027.

section_b.rule: The Semester Fee for Even Semester 2027 has a due date of 15 March 2027.

description: Section 4.1 of academic_regulations.md states 10 March 2027, while the fee_deadlines.csv entry referenced to Section 4.1 states 15 March 2027.

section_a.rule: Residents must return to the hostel by 10:00 PM. Returning after 10:00 PM constitutes a curfew violation.

section_b.rule: Residents may enter the hostel until 11:00 PM. Entry before 11:00 PM does not constitute a curfew violation.

description: Section 6.3 treats entry after 10:00 PM as a violation, while Section 6.4 permits entry until 11:00 PM without treating it as a violation.
